name: 19317 · Chadds Ford, PA
findings: ZIP 19317 (Chadds Ford) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19317 (Chadds Ford) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
